easyManagerProjects.viewsWelcome.favorit:
No projects saved yet.
Pick any folder on this computer to save it as a project:
[Add Folder to Favorites](command:easyManagerProjects.addFolderToFavorites)
Or open a folder or workspace first:
[Open Folder](command:_easyManagerProjects.openFolderWelcome)
[Open Workspace from File](command:workbench.action.openWorkspace)
To learn more about how to use Lemari in VS Code [read the docs](https://github.com/exeldtarkus/easy-manager-projects#readme).

No projects saved yet.
Save the current folder or workspace:
[Save Project](command:easyManagerProjects.saveProject)
Or pick any other folder:
[Add Folder to Favorites](command:easyManagerProjects.addFolderToFavorites)

easyManagerProjects.viewsWelcome.git.con:
No projects detected.
Pick the folders where your Git repositories live, and every repository inside is listed here:
[Add Git Base Folder](command:easyManagerProjects.addGitBaseFolder)
[Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22easyManagerProjects.git.baseFolders%22%5D)
[I don't need Git projects](command:easyManagerProjects.hideGitWelcome)
It also supports detection of SVN or Mercurial repositories, VS Code or any other folder.
To learn more about how to use Lemari in VS Code [read the docs](https://github.com/exeldtarkus/easy-manager-projects#readme).

easyManagerProjects.configuration.showPr: Should display the project name in the Status Bar?
easyManagerProjects.configuration.openIn: Should the project be opened using a New Window when you click the Status Bar?
easyManagerProjects.configuration.remove: Should the current project be hidden in the list of available projects?
easyManagerProjects.configuration.sortLi: List the projects sorted by...(Saved, Name, Path or Recent)
easyManagerProjects.configuration.groupL: Group the project list by kind, Favorites first, then Git, VSCode, Mercurial, SVN and Any
easyManagerProjects.configuration.projec: Indicates an alternative location (folder path) where the `projects.json` file is stored
easyManagerProjects.configuration.vscode: Indicates folders or [glob patterns](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) to search for VSCode projects
Indicates folders or [glob patterns](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) to be ignored when searching for projects
Indicates the maximum depth of folder recursion to search for projects. Any value below 1 means there is no limit
easyManagerProjects.configuration.git.ba: Indicates folders or [glob patterns](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) to search for Git projects
easyManagerProjects.configuration.git.ig: Indicates folders or [glob patterns](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) to be ignored when searching for projects
easyManagerProjects.configuration.git.ma: Indicates the maximum depth of folder recursion to search for projects. Any value below 1 means there is no limit

Display the Git branch name only in the Side Bar
Display the Git branch name only in the Command Palette
Display the Git branch name in all locations
easyManagerProjects.configuration.hg.bas: Indicates folders or [glob patterns](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) to search for Mercurial projects
easyManagerProjects.configuration.hg.ign: Indicates folders or [glob patterns](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) to be ignored when searching for projects
easyManagerProjects.configuration.hg.max: Indicates the maximum depth of folder recursion to search for projects. Any value below 1 means there is no limit
easyManagerProjects.configuration.svn.ba: Indicates folders or [glob patterns](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) to search for SVN projects
easyManagerProjects.configuration.svn.ig: Indicates folders or [glob patterns](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) to be ignored when searching for projects
easyManagerProjects.configuration.svn.ma: Indicates the maximum depth of folder recursion to search for projects. Any value below 1 means there is no limit
easyManagerProjects.configuration.any.ba: Indicates folders or [glob patterns](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) to search for any folder projects
easyManagerProjects.configuration.any.ig: Indicates folders or [glob patterns](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) to be ignored when searching for projects
easyManagerProjects.configuration.any.ex: Exclude the base folders themselves from the auto-detected projects list

easyManagerProjects.configuration.cacheP: Should cache the VSCode, Git and SVN projects found?
easyManagerProjects.configuration.ignore: Should ignore projects found inside other projects?
easyManagerProjects.configuration.checkI: Should check for invalid paths before listing, showing a message below the project name?
easyManagerProjects.configuration.showPa: Should show the parent folder info when projects with same name are detected?
easyManagerProjects.configuration.filter: Match the typed text against the project path too, not only the name
easyManagerProjects.configuration.openIn: Indicates if the New Window command open the project in current window, when empty.
Indicates if the New Window command open the project in current window, when empty.
easyManagerProjects.configuration.confir: Controls whether the extension should ask for confirmation when opening projects in the active window.
easyManagerProjects.configuration.tags.d: Indicates the list of tags you can use to organize your projects

Quickly access all your projects in the **Command Palette** and it its exclusive **Side Bar**.
